title: (How) Does User-Generated Content Impact Content Generated by Professionals? Evidence from Local News
eligible_reason: Single-date shock: new_website switches on for all authors and regions in the same week (removal of the citizen-journalist status index on 26 Sep 2018, week 3052); regressions are before/after comparisons with author FE and a holiday-week control (no calendar-time FE), estimated separately by author group, plus IV and continuous distance interactions. Data are not shipped (NDA with the platform).
design_notes: Author-week panel 8 weeks before/after 26 Sep 2018 (weeks 3045-3061), meinbezirk.at network of 122 local outlets. Tables 2-8: reghdfe art_auth new_website holiday_week, absorb(author_id), by author type/experience; ivreghdfe; region-level ltrarticles on new_website x driving time; article-level ln_clicks. Figures 3-6: weekly coefficients ib3052.week with author FE.
estimators_reported: interrupted time series with unit FE

specs.exclusion_reason: single common adoption week for all units; no calendar-time FE; holiday_week control; data not shipped

data_provenance_note: Stata_Readme: datasets cannot be posted because of NDAs and European privacy rules; access via GOGOL Medien / meinbezirk.at. Only a public Statistics Austria regional classification file is shipped.
software_notes: Stata 16 for tables/figures; R for text classification, Google Trends, Google Maps distances.
screener_notes: Not staggered and no data. Screened from package only.
